notes: url: the class leaderboard site; its data is read from <url>data/. term: null reads the current term; an archived term's label (see <url>data/archive/index.json) pins that term instead. featured: a board slug from <url>data/index.json pins that board while it has ranked laps (Cedric, 2026-09-25: stay on lab 4, follow the gap); null picks the most recently opened lab that has ranked laps. extra: the one extra column (a metric.extras key), null for none. limit: rows shown. replay: the board's own player beside the table, loaded on click (<url>?lab=<board>&compare=<compare>, compare is top3 or top5); it follows the board chips; null hides it. See docs/LEADERBOARD.md.
